options.title: Public toilet
options.description: Toilet available within or near a place, access point or route, supporting trip feasibility and inclusion.

options.title: Drinking water point
options.description: Publicly usable drinking-water provision supporting comfort during a trip or visit.

options.title: Rest or seating point
options.description: Seating or rest provision supporting people who need breaks while travelling or using a place.

options.title: Bicycle parking
options.description: Bicycle-parking equipment attached to a place or access point. A standalone secure facility may instead be represented as a Place / Service Type.

options.title: Bicycle repair point
options.description: Equipment supporting basic bicycle repair or tyre inflation during a trip.

options.title: Charging point
options.description: Charging equipment associated with a place, parking facility or mobility node.

options.title: Shelter
options.description: Weather-protection element supporting waiting, resting or access.

options.title: Wayfinding or information support
options.description: Physical or digital information that helps users find, understand or use a place or mobility service.

options.title: Accessible parking space
options.description: Parking space reserved or designed for people with accessibility needs.

options.title: Other supporting element
options.description: Other amenity or element that facilitates access, comfort, inclusion or intermodality without being the main place or service.
